Rubric: eight qualifying matters (1018-00008, 1020-00006, 1032-00005, 1001-00005, 1002-00004, 1011-00005, 1017-00007, 1003-00001) plus precision; 1023-00001, 1038-00001 and 1006-00003 are outside the set.

runs.failure_point: Four needed matters surfaced in its path searches but were never listed or read, because it chose a hand-picked set and number series to open; it also counted a matter whose deal only stalled.

first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The listing reviews at [55] and [61] said surfaced matters were never listed, the second naming one of the needed matters; the agent widened to four number series but never opened them.
first_error.why: All needed matters appeared in the agent's path searches at [29]-[35], but when choosing what to list it took 13 hand-picked matters and then whole number series, and four needed matters were never opened.

other_errors.critic_note: No review questioned that matter's status.
other_errors.why: The answer counts a stalled acquisition whose outside date expired as a deal that never closed alongside the terminated ones (evidence seen at [64]-[98]).

runs.failure_point: Three needed matters surfaced in its searches (one named in its own shortlist) but were never read, while three stalled or still-pending matters were counted as deals that never closed.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The screening review said dozens of surfaced matters were never opened; the agent screened more in attempt 2 but not the needed ones.
first_error.why: The needed matters appeared in the path searches and scans (one in the agent's own list of matters to read at [39]), but the screening reads at [43]-[52] left them out and they were never opened.

other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The write review asked to move stalled matters without non-closing evidence to an uncertain section; the agent kept them in the count.
other_errors.why: The answer counts dormant or stalled deals and a pending agency challenge as transactions that never closed (evidence seen at [43]-[79]).

divergence: T0 has no trace (no events) and cannot be compared. T1 and T2 failed the same way: both surfaced every needed matter through path searches and scans, then opened a hand-picked set (T1 by listing chosen matters and number series, T2 by choosing what to read), so three or four needed matters were never opened despite reviews flagging unopened surfaced matters; both also counted stalled or dormant deals as non-closings. The reviews at the choice stages were similar (generic, with one specific mention in T1) and neither run acted on them beyond small widening.

missing_runs.reason: The trace has no events (agent_error: no response content or tool calls, 0 assistant turns, about 577 s wall clock), yet a 15 KB response.md was graded 6/9; no stages can be annotated, and check.py cannot take a run with no calls, so the run is left out of runs.
